title: Lane verdicts carry the command and exit behind every claim about an external system
body:
Why: 2026-11-13 two lanes reported confident false facts: #688 claimed the pilot lacked krn.json and spec/ci-admission.json (it read with a krn-scoped token and got 404); #684 claimed a vitest receiver but used node --test. The lead caught both only by rerunning against the real receiver.
Outcome: the lane verdict template requires, for every claim about an external system, the exact command and its exit code, and krn lane brief adds that line; the lead reruns one such command per lane before accepting.
